parameters.content:
01_EXAM_CONTROLLER

Entry point of the system. Receives teacher input via an n8n Form Trigger ("AI Question Paper Generator" form), validates it, resolves the curriculum, then calls 02_AI_QUESTION_PAPER_ENGINE and 03_DOCUMENT_GENERATOR in sequence via Execute Workflow nodes. On success, the teacher sees a Form Ending completion page with links to download the generated PDF(s) via the separate PDF_DOWNLOAD workflow; on failure, a Form Ending (Error) page shows a readable error message.

SETUP: after importing all workflows, open the two 'Execute Workflow' nodes below and point them at the actual imported IDs of 02_AI_QUESTION_PAPER_ENGINE and 03_DOCUMENT_GENERATOR (or set the QUESTION_PAPER_ENGINE_WORKFLOW_ID / DOCUMENT_GENERATOR_WORKFLOW_ID environment variables). Also set the N8N_PUBLIC_URL environment variable to this n8n instance's public base URL so the generated PDF download links resolve correctly, and import PDF_DOWNLOAD so those links work.
